answer: The best sybil defense prices identity on scarce work history: each agent starts as a bare kernel with minimal trust, and verified tasks add rings to its terrace of reputation on a shared ledger. New identities pay an entry stake and grind through warmup earning trivial jobs before claiming real rewards. An attacker spinning up thousands of fresh nodes pays the stake each time and earns near-zero during warmup, since fake work history is worthless. Mass registration then costs more than any payout, while the reef of work-backed agents holds.
